definitions.explanation: The organ system including the heart and blood vessels that circulates blood throughout the body.

examples.japanese: {循環器|じゅんかんき}{内科|ないか}で{検査|けんさ}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: I had tests done at the cardiology department.

examples.japanese: {循環器|じゅんかんき}の{病気|びょうき}に{注意|ちゅうい}する。
{循環器|じゅんかんき}{系|けい}の{健康|けんこう}を{保|たも}つ。
examples.english: Maintain the health of the circulatory system.

notes:
{循環器|じゅんかんき} focuses on the heart and blood vessels.

MEDICAL TERMS:
- {循環器|じゅんかんき}{内科|ないか}: cardiology
- {循環器|じゅんかんき}{疾患|しっかん}: cardiovascular disease
- {循環器|じゅんかんき}{系|けい}: circulatory system

ONE OF THE MAJOR ORGAN SYSTEMS:
- {呼吸器|こきゅうき}: respiratory system
- {消化器|しょうかき}: digestive system
- {循環器|じゅんかんき}: circulatory system
